request.task: Construct and execute a complete JWRS AI-NLE procedure for dispatching messages to Google Gemini, making response type, input files, heuristics, instructions, and all evidenced runtime categories configurable.

ai_nle_procedure.purpose: Define and enforce a natural-language-executable procedure for assembling, validating, dispatching, and persisting configurable message interactions with Google Gemini, ensuring full coverage of evidenced configuration categories, state tracking, and live verification.

definitions.AI-NLE: An AI natural-language executor capable of executing procedural steps with bounded judgment and explicit authority adherence.
definitions.JWRS: JSON-Wrapped Request and Specification format requiring explicit projections, verifiable schemas, and structured artifact delivery.
definitions.Run Nonce: A path-safe, run-scoped alphanumeric string isolating execution transcripts, intermediate logs, and persisted outcomes.
definitions.Live Ground Truth: Authoritative live evidence derived from runtime filesystem, environment, and API receipts rather than self-reported assertions.

inputs.runtime_config: Active configuration JSON defining endpoints, generation parameters, path mappings, input bindings, and validation rules.
inputs.trigger_envelope: Optional trigger JSON supplying a run nonce, user message, or dynamic instruction overrides.
inputs.generic_inputs: Declared input files and literal values loaded and formatted into prompt sections.
inputs.credentials: Host environment variable containing the active Gemini API key.

api.key_env: Name of the environment variable containing the API key (e.g., GEMINI_API_KEY).
api.timeout_ms: Request timeout in milliseconds before triggering an abort signal.
api.max_retries: Number of retry attempts for transient HTTP/network errors.

generation.max_output_tokens: Maximum token budget for generated content.

paths.runtime_root: Root directory for relative path resolution.
paths.runs_root: Directory where run-isolated execution containers are created.
paths.trigger_file: Path to trigger envelope file supplying dynamic run parameters.
paths.messages_file: Output path for the accumulated message stream JSON.
paths.output_file: Filename for the parsed structured response payload.
paths.latest_output_file: Optional compatibility path for root-level mirror of output.
paths.write_latest_outputs: Boolean controlling root-level compatibility mirror creation.

run.nonce_param: Key name used to extract run nonce from trigger envelopes.
run.nonce_regex: Validation pattern for run nonces ensuring path safety.
run.default_nonce_prefix: Prefix used when generating timestamps for fallback nonces.
run.reuse_history: Boolean indicating whether preexisting messages at the target should be loaded as conversation history.

prompt.system_instruction: Authoritative system-level instructions governing model role and constraints.
prompt.heuristic: Authoritative evaluation heuristic or operative guidance.
prompt.output_schema: Expected JSON schema structure communicated to the model.
prompt.template_prefix: Introductory prompt context preceding input dumps.
prompt.template_suffix: Closing prompt directives following input dumps.

configuration_contract.inputs: Array of input specifications: [{ key, type, path, value, numbered, required }].

validation.expected_response_type: Required string value for the response_type field in model output.
validation.require_json: Boolean requiring output to parse as valid JSON.
validation.strip_markdown_fence: Boolean authorizing extraction of JSON from markdown fences.
validation.allow_repair: Boolean authorizing structured repair prompt loops on parse/schema failure.

procedure.name: load_configuration_and_environment
procedure.instruction: Read config.json from working directory or command line argument; verify API key presence in process.env; establish absolute paths for runtime root and run output directories.

procedure.name: resolve_run_identity_and_trigger
procedure.instruction: Check for trigger_file; extract or generate a validated path-safe run_nonce; initialize run directory under runs_root/<run_nonce>.

procedure.name: load_and_format_inputs
procedure.instruction: Iterate through configured input descriptors; read referenced files or literals; apply line-numbering if configured; verify existence of required inputs.

procedure.name: assemble_message_contents
procedure.instruction: Construct system_instruction text from prompt configuration; compile user content combining heuristic, template, and labeled input sections; load prior history if reuse_history is enabled.

procedure.name: execute_gemini_request
procedure.instruction: Serialize API payload and dispatch HTTP POST to the Gemini endpoint with abort signal timeout and exponential backoff retry loop for transient failures.

procedure.name: extract_and_validate_response
procedure.instruction: Validate HTTP 200; extract model candidate parts; parse JSON with markdown fence stripping; assert presence of expected_response_type.

procedure.name: persist_transcripts_and_artifacts
procedure.instruction: Append model response to conversation history; write messages.json and output_file to the isolated run directory; update latest compatibility mirrors if configured.

validation.pre_execution: API key present in environment; configuration passes schema sanity; inputs exist.
validation.runtime: HTTP response OK (200); candidate parts contain non-empty text; text parses to valid JSON object.
validation.post_execution: Output file and transcript written atomically; expected_response_type matches exactly.

failure_handling.missing_credentials: Exit code 1 with deterministic diagnostic message specifying missing key_env.
failure_handling.input_read_failure: Exit code 1 with path identification for missing required input.
failure_handling.http_error: Capture status and body error JSON; retry up to max_retries if 429/5xx; otherwise fail gracefully.
failure_handling.malformed_json: Attempt regex-based markdown fence removal; if still invalid, write raw error artifact and terminate.

invariants: Every run must execute an active dispatch rather than inferring completion from preexisting artifacts.
Run nonces must be strictly validated against path-safe regex to prevent directory traversal.
All output artifacts must be persisted in run-isolated directories.
Deterministic runtime findings and transcripts must be saved before process exit.

gemini-message-workflow.yaml:
name: Execute Gemini Message Procedure
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      config_file:
        description: 'Path to configuration JSON'
        required: false
        default: 'config.json'
      model_override:
        description: 'Gemini model override'
        required: false
        default: ''
      trigger_nonce:
        description: 'Optional execution run nonce override'
        required: false
        default: ''

jobs:
  execute-message:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js Runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Execute Gemini Message Procedure
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          GEMINI_MODEL: ${{ github.event.inputs.model_override }}
        run: |
          node gemini-message-executor.js "${{ github.event.inputs.config_file || 'config.json' }}"

      - name: Upload Run Output Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: gemini-message-run-artifacts
          path: runs/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

prompt.system_instruction: You are a deterministic AI Natural-Language Executor. You must execute all procedural instructions strictly according to configured authorities and return one valid JSON object complying with the specified schema.
prompt.heuristic: Execute the assigned procedure, grounding all assertions in live evidence and honoring explicit composition, state tracking, and return contract closure.
prompt.template_prefix: Executing configured procedure under active JWRS contract.
prompt.template_suffix: Ensure output strictly adheres to the requested JSON schema.
